{{Top|leg}}
The '''T-32S light blaster''' was a model of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that was produced during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They contained focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that were [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], and attained popularity among [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] as a result of their small size and powerful penetrative abilities.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
